thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/21/2018: ABIL, CMCM, ADSK, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/21/2018: ABIL, CMCM, ADSK, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.46%
AAPL: +1.02%
IBM: +0.45%
CSCO: +0.70%
GOOG: +0.90%
Technology stocks were inching higher pre-market Wednesday.
Early movers include:
(+) Ability ( ABIL ), which was rallying by more than 27% after it unveiled an agreement to acquire the developer of Ultimate Interception, its principal cellular interception system.
(+) Cheetah Mobile ( CMCM ) was up by more that 10% as it posted Q3 adjusted earnings of RMB1.27 ($0.18) per American depositary share, up from RMB1.10 per ADS a year ago and higher than the RMB1.16 per ADS estimate provided by Capital IQ.
(+) Autodesk ( ADSK ) was more than 8% higher after it agreed to acquire construction productivity software developer PlanGrid for $875 million, net of cash.
